Magic: The Gathering Streets of New Capenna Draft Booster | 15 Magic Cards

KEY PRODUCT FEATURES
• 15 Magic: The Gathering cards per booster
• Best booster for drafting Streets of New Capenna
• Rare or Mythic Rare card in every pack
• Traditional foil in 33% of SNC Draft Boosters
• Join one of five powerful families and build your criminal empire

DESCRIPTION Draft Boosters are specifically designed for the best Magic: The Gathering booster draft play experience. Each Streets of New Capenna Draft Booster contains 15 Magic cards and 1 token, ad card, or counter punchout card, with a combination of 1 card of rarity Rare or higher and 3 Uncommon, 10 Common, and 1 Land cards. A traditional foil card of any rarity replaces a Common in 33% of Streets of New Capenna Draft Boosters. Traditional foil Borderless Mythic Planeswalker in <1% of boosters.
